about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the dark and unsettling world of Nightmare Within with the official game soundtrack.

This carefully crafted collection of compositions unveils the emotional core of the story — guilt, loss, and the inner conflict of the protagonist. Each track is an essential part of the game’s atmosphere, reflecting distorted perception and the fragile nature of the human mind.

Includes:

  • The complete original soundtrack composed exclusively for the game

  • Orchestral and ambient pieces accompanying key moments and cutscenes

  • Character themes that mirror psychological states and memories

  • A bonus track created exclusively for the Steam release

Format:

  • All tracks in high-quality MP3 and FLAC formats

  • Over 60 minutes of original music

Let these sounds guide you once again through the corridors of memory — where every echo is a reflection of inner horror.
